answer: Work is paid only after real use: the filer posts it on an Island page, and the Plume ledger counts distinct users, winding the spiral tally. Ten users within a month release the payout; fewer voids the claim and forfeits a 500-coin bond, and faked usage bars the user a month. One honest worker risks one bond; 1,000 fakes would need 10,000 real users, losing 500,000 coins. One farm posted forty works no one opened; every bond was gone in a month.
